title: 第23章 灵膳楼
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
三天后的傍晚，苏荇拿到了玄阶丹师的正式徽章。

    她到棚子的时候林尘正把最后一炉清心丹从青铜炉里取出来。

    这几天他用御灵符阵反复测试灵纹融合的极限，成丹率已经从三成提到了七成，炉底那道铁皮补丁倒是纹丝不动，没再炸过。

    “走吧，灵膳楼。”她把徽章别在领口，银质药鼎胸针旁边多了一枚刻着丹纹的金色徽章，在炉火下微微发亮，“说好了请你吃饭，不吃白不吃。”

    灵膳楼在五柳城北街，是城里为数不多专做灵材菜肴的酒楼。

    门口挂着一串风干的灵菇，空气里弥漫着灵草炖肉和药材煲汤的混合香气。

    苏荇显然提前订好了位子——二楼靠窗的雅座，推开窗就能看到五柳城的夜景，街上灵石灯渐次亮起，像一条蜿蜒的光河。

    “你点菜。这里的招牌是灵芝炖雪鸡，赤芝增灵，雪鸡肉嫩，对筑基期修士正好合适。”苏荇把菜单推到他面前，自己只点了一壶清茶。

    林尘看了看菜单上的价格，一道灵芝炖雪鸡就要三十灵石，快赶上徐老头半个摊子的日营业额了。

    “你刚拿到徽章，还没接第一单生意就这么花？”

    “请你吃饭不算花，算投资。丹道真解第三卷有一章讲灵力感知对炼丹的影响，我看了三遍都没看明白——你一个学了几天的人却能直接感知灵纹流转，这一顿饭换你帮我讲清楚那章的内容，算下来是我赚了。”

    林尘点了灵芝炖雪鸡和几个配菜，把菜单还给跑堂的伙计。

    “那章讲什么。”

    “讲炼丹师的灵力感知分三个层次。第一层是靠观火镜看灵纹颜色变化，大部分黄阶丹师一辈子都停在这一层。第二层是脱离观火镜，直接用灵力感知灵纹流转——能做到这一层的至少是玄阶上品，五柳城炼丹师行会的考官就是这一层。第三层是不仅能感知灵纹，还能主动引导灵纹融合的方向，这种人在整个下三州的炼丹师里屈指可数。”她顿了一下，手指在茶杯边缘轻轻划了一圈，“你现在在第一层和第二层之间——你用观火镜辅助，但已经能直接感知灵纹流转。但你能更进一步。”

    “怎么更进一步。”

    “你炼的清心丹灵纹网络比标准丹方密了一倍，我在观火镜下看过——每一条灵纹的末端都多了一个淡金色节点。那不是炼丹技巧的产物，是你的灵力本身在丹药内部留下了印记。这种印记对服用者会产生灵力共鸣，效果大概相当于把服用者的灵纹感知力直接提升一个台阶。我这几天成丹率从三成提到六成，你以为是我突然开窍了？不是，是我吃多了你炼的丹。”

    灵芝炖雪鸡端上来的时候，桌上腾起一片白茫茫的热气。苏荇夹了一块鸡肉放进林尘碗里，又给自己倒了杯茶。

    “趁热吃，灵芝的药性一凉就散了。”
content_en:
Three days later in the evening, Su Yun received the official badge of Xuanjie Alchemist.

    When she arrived at the shed, Lin Chen was taking out the last batch of Qingxin Pills from the bronze furnace.

    In the past few days, he has repeatedly tested the limits of spirit pattern fusion with the spirit-controlling talisman array. The rate of pill formation has increased from 30% to 70%. The iron patch on the bottom of the furnace has not moved at all and has not exploded again.

    "Let's go, Lingshan Tower." She pinned the badge on her collar. Next to the silver medicine cauldron brooch, there was a golden badge engraved with a red pattern, which shone slightly under the fire. "I agreed to treat you to a meal. If you don't eat, you won't get it."

    Lingshan Restaurant is located on Wuliucheng North Street and is one of the few restaurants in the city that specializes in spiritual dishes.

    A bunch of dried mushrooms hang at the door, and the air is filled with the mixed aroma of mushroom stew and medicinal soup.

    Su Xin had obviously reserved a seat in advance - a seat by the window on the second floor. When you open the window, you can see the night view of Wuliu City. The street lamps gradually light up, like a winding river of light.

    "You order. The signature here is snow chicken stewed with Ganoderma lucidum. The red mushroom increases the spirit and the snow chicken is tender. It is just right for the monks in the foundation period." Su Yun pushed the menu in front of him and only ordered a pot of tea.

    Lin Chen looked at the prices on the menu. A dish of stewed snow chicken with Ganoderma lucidum cost thirty spirit stones, which was almost as much as Old Man Xu's half of his stall's daily turnover.

    "You just got the badge and you haven't even taken your first business, so you're spending it like this?"

    "It's not a expense to treat you to a meal, it's an investment. There is a chapter in the third volume of the True Solution to Alchemy that talks about the impact of spiritual power perception on alchemy. I read it three times and I still can't understand it - you, a person who has only studied for a few days, can directly sense the flow of spiritual patterns. This meal is for you to help me explain the content of that chapter clearly. After all, I have made a profit."

    Lin Chen ordered Ganoderma lucidum stewed snow chicken and a few side dishes, and returned the menu to the waiter.

    "What's that chapter about?"

    "The alchemist's spiritual power perception is divided into three levels. The first level is to rely on the fire viewing mirror to see the color changes of the spirit patterns. Most yellow-level alchemists stay at this level all their lives. The second level is to break away from the fire viewing mirror and directly use spiritual power to sense the flow of the spiritual patterns. Those who can do this are at least high-ranking Xuan-level people, and the examiners of the Wuliu City Alchemist Guild are at this level. The third level is There are only a handful of alchemists in the entire Lower Sanzhou who can not only sense the spirit patterns, but also actively guide the direction of the spirit patterns." She paused and lightly traced a circle on the edge of the tea cup. "You are now between the first and second levels - you use the fire viewing mirror to assist, but you can already directly sense the flow of the spirit patterns."

    "How to go further."

    "The network of spiritual patterns of the Qingxin Pill you refined is twice as dense as the standard pill recipe. I saw it under the fire viewing mirror - there is an extra light golden node at the end of each spiritual pattern. That is not the product of the alchemy skills, but your spiritual power itself left a mark inside the pill. This This mark will have a spiritual resonance on the user, and the effect is probably equivalent to directly improving the user's spiritual pattern perception. In the past few days, my pill yield rate has increased from 30% to 60%. Do you think it's because I suddenly became enlightened? No, it's because I took too much of the pills you made."

    When the snow chicken stewed with Ganoderma lucidum was served, a white steam rose from the table. Su Yun put a piece of chicken into Lin Chen's bowl and poured herself a cup of tea.

    "Eat it while it's hot, as the medicinal properties of Ganoderma dissipate once it cools down."
